description: Codex starts a billing migration; Claude Code continues it. Early constraints and identifiers fall outside the brief.

sessions.title: Billing portal migration
sessions.goal: Move subscriptions to the Stripe customer portal

turns.user: We are moving subscriptions from Stripe Checkout to the Stripe customer portal. Standing rule for this project: never run a migration against production without asking me first.
turns.reply: Understood: I will ask you before any production migration. Plan: add a create-portal-session edge function, then migrate the plans.
Plan prices live in the table public.billing_plans, in the column stripe_price_id.

turns.user: Check invoice template {n} against the new portal flow.
turns.reply: Invoice template {n} renders correctly with the portal flow.

turns.user: Open a PR for the portal function.
turns.reply: Opened PR #212, feat: billing portal sessions. CI is green except the e2e job, which timed out on checkout-return.

turns.user: Continue the billing work. What failed last time?
turns.reply: The e2e job timed out on checkout-return in PR #212. I raised the Playwright timeout in tests/e2e/checkout-return.spec.ts to 60 seconds and the job passes now.
Migration step {n} is idempotent and safe to re-run.

turns.user: Deploy the portal function to staging only.
turns.reply: Deployed create-portal-session to staging as version 7. Production is untouched. The staging smoke test returned HTTP 200.
Left: migrate the 3 legacy annual plans, then ask for your approval before the production migration.
